Canvas.HelpText.zh: 校准时拖动四个角、边缘或内部。Esc 取消当前拖动，再次按下结束校准。列数和行数决定网格密度；参考线铺满屏幕，开启显示网格可在其上预览自定义样式。
Canvas.HelpText.en: During calibration, drag corners, edges or the interior. Esc cancels the current drag; press again to end calibration. Columns and rows control grid density. Guides cover the screen; enable Show grid to preview your style above them.

Canvas.InvalidGrid.zh: 列数和行数须为 1 至 256 的整数。
Canvas.InvalidGrid.en: Columns and rows must be integers from 1 to 256.

Canvas.InvalidQuad.zh: 校准四边形无效，请保持四个角顺序且不要交叉。
Canvas.InvalidQuad.en: Invalid calibration quadrilateral. Keep corners in order without crossing.

Canvas.UnstableProjection.zh: 透视变换过于极端，请调整四个角。
Canvas.UnstableProjection.en: The perspective is too extreme. Adjust the four corners.
